Preserve THIS exact character identity, age, hairstyle, hair color, hat, clothing colors, scarf, vest, accessories, facial hair and recognizable original pose. Create a SINGLE character on a genuinely transparent background. Portrait canvas 2:3. Framing MUST show the entire hat/head, both shoulders, both arms and hands, torso, waist and belt; bottom ends slightly below the belt. Natural adult proportions, small head occupying only about 22 percent of image height, NOT a bust/avatar/large head. Keep 6 percent padding around silhouette, nothing clipped. Crisp visible square pixel clusters similar to a 170x250 logical sprite enlarged cleanly, curated limited warm palette with 4-6 shades per material, stylized facial features, no photoreal pores or smooth gradients, no painted outline blur. The pose and clothes must match the source, not redesigned. No background or glow, no text.

Use case: style-transfer. Edit this exact research desk background into elegant medium-fine hand-clustered pixel art for a warm harbour tavern game. KEEP EXACTLY the original image's composition, perspective, placement and sizes of all key objects: left lantern and maps, large open illustrated notebook at lower-left to center with drink drawing on its LEFT page and blank RIGHT page, upper-right closed leather manuscript with blank cream label, lower-right wooden recipe card box with blank cream label, far-right highball drink, harbour sunset view beyond the desk. Pixel art at roughly 640x360 logical resolution displayed at 1920x1080, crisp square pixel clusters and controlled warm palette, rich wooden/leather material shading, some small brass highlights. Simplify ornamental noise but preserve craftsmanship and original recognizable design. The notebook and both label areas must remain clear for overlaid Chinese UI; NO letters or buttons baked into image. Absolutely do not rearrange objects or replace books with bottles. Full 16:9 landscape game background, opaque.
